slot.brief: From the letters of a given word (each letter used as many times as it appears), determine which of the given words can or cannot be formed.

stem: From the letters of the word CALENDAR, which of the following words can be formed, each letter being used only as many times as it appears in CALENDAR?

verdicts.working: CALENDAR has A twice; C, L, E, N, D, R once each. DANCER uses only available letters. The other choices require an extra C, an extra E, or unavailable G and extra R.
